config_options.description: List of configuration options to apply to apt-rdepends. Each entry defines a key-value pair corresponding to apt-rdepends options or APT configuration options (-o syntax). For each item, 'key' is the configuration key (e.g., 'Follow', 'Show', 'StateFollow', 'StateShow'), and 'value' is the string representation of the option value (e.g., 'Depends,PreDepends'). Note: Only keys that map to apt-rdepends command-line options or APT config options are valid. See man apt-rdepends(1).
